title: Backdoor Decontamination Dynamics in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.11295v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-weight LLM agents are vulnerable to backdoors installed during fine-tuning, which may be undetectable if the trigger conditions are never met during testing. Assuming defenders do not know the existing trigger, they cannot unlearn it directly. One decontamination strategy is to install a known backdoor (defensive poisoning) then to unlearn it, hoping that the original unknown backdoor is removed as a side effect. However, this procedure has uncertain outcomes: the original backdoor may persist or be erased or rerouted, among other possibilities. We introduce a framework for studying these dynamics in tool-calling agents, decoupling trigger, response, teacher, and fine-tuning method across systematic experiments on AgentDyn. translated_title: 大语言模型智能体中的后门净化动力学
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11295v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：开放权重的大语言模型智能体容易受到微调过程中安装的后门攻击，如果测试期间从未触发触发条件，这些后门可能无法被检测到。假设防御者不知道现有触发器，他们无法直接消除它。一种净化策略是先安装一个已知后门（防御性投毒），然后将其消除，希望原始未知后门作为副作用被移除。然而，这一过程的结果不确定：原始后门可能持续存在、被擦除或被重定向，以及其他可能性。我们引入了一个框架来研究工具调用智能体中的这些动力学，在AgentDyn上系统性地解耦触发器、响应、教师和微调方法。在115次实验中，仅防御性投毒就能擦除约56%的原始后门；随后的净化处理几乎将所有幸存者推向擦除，证实了触发器识别和恶意行为消除的联动效应。
tldr: 本研究提出一种框架，通过防御性投毒与后续净化相结合的方法，在工具调用智能体中有效消除未知后门，实验显示该方法能擦除绝大多数原始后门。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a framework combining defensive poisoning and subsequent decontamination to effectively eliminate unknown backdoors in tool-calling agents, with experiments showing the method erases the vast majority of original backdoors.
